city.name: Zagreb
city.differential: FabLab Hrvatska brings practical STEAM learning to Zagreb through public events in Sesvete and hands-on digital fabrication.
city.description: Fab City Zagreb is coordinated by FabLab Hrvatska. Its work connects education, local communities and partners through workshops, public events and digital fabrication. The full local website documents the initiative and its activities.

ecosystem.name: FabLab Hrvatska
ecosystem.summary: Coordinates the Fab City Zagreb initiative and connects practical learning, digital fabrication and local collaboration.

ecosystem.name: Zelene i plave Sesvete
ecosystem.summary: Co-organises STEM Fest Sesvete with FabLab Hrvatska, bringing science, technology and hands-on learning to the local community.

projects.title: STEMerica ide dalje
projects.summary: Led by FabLab Hrvatska from 2025 to 2028, this programme runs interactive STEM workshops and public events for children, young people and communities across Croatia.

news.title: FabLab Hrvatska explores biomaterials with ZMAG
news.summary: At the Recycled Estate in Vukomerić, FabLab shared its 3D-printing work with biodegradable materials and discussed future collaboration with ZMAG.

events.title: STEM Fest Sesvete
events.venue: Former Sljeme factory, Ulica Ivana Keleka 2, Sesvete

ui_labels.part_of_network: Part of the Fab City Network
